description: Repo-level exceptions to the shared preset. Each rule names the upstream constraint that blocks the upgrade; remove the rule when the constraint clears.
Closing a grouped major PR does not stop Renovate re-proposing it (#208 closed 2026-09-03, #209 opened with identical content), so blocked majors must be disabled here.

packageRules.description: eslint-plugin-react (7.37.5) peers eslint <= ^9.7; ESLint 10 breaks pnpm lint with react/display-name getFilename errors. Re-enable when the plugin ships ESLint 10 support.
typescript-eslint (8.69.0) peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. Re-enable when typescript-eslint supports TS 7.

The ajv@<7 and nanoid@<4 selectors in pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides deliberately pin those old majors for consumers that need them (ajv 7 rewrote its API; nanoid 4+ is ESM-only). Bumping the override value across the major boundary breaks them at runtime, not at install.
